free_tier.stated: GitHub Free: 10 GiB of Git LFS storage and 10 GiB of Git LFS download bandwidth per month, the bandwidth quota resetting at the start of each billing cycle
free_tier.notes: download bandwidth is metered separately; above the monthly bandwidth quota with no payment method on file, Git LFS support is disabled until the next month

egress.terms: Git LFS download bandwidth: 10 GiB included on GitHub Free, then billed for each GiB downloaded; uploads are not counted as bandwidth

evidence.proved: GitHub Free includes 10 GiB of Git LFS bandwidth and 10 GiB of Git LFS storage
the bandwidth quota is monthly; above it with no payment method, Git LFS is disabled until the next month
evidence.quote: If you use more than your included quota of bandwidth per month without a payment method on file, Git LFS support is disabled on your account until the next month.

evidence.proved: storage counts the bytes of every Git LFS object held by a repository
evidence.quote: Git LFS storage is calculated based on all Git LFS objects associated with a repository, regardless of when they were uploaded.

evidence.proved: download bandwidth above the included amount is billed per GiB
evidence.quote: Bandwidth is billed for each GiB of data downloaded.

evidence.proved: uploads count toward storage and not toward bandwidth
evidence.quote: When you upload a file to Git LFS, the file is included in the repository owner's storage use but the bandwidth is not measured.
